verdict.rationale: Galileo's 'Experiments' feature lets you evaluate prompts, models, and app code against chosen metrics, and the console UI provides 'Create Experiment' buttons to add these to a project, implying some run-level comparison capability; MCP also exposes running experiments programmatically. However, there is no explicit documentation of a side-by-side comparison view, diffing prompt/model versions, or regression-flagging between experiment runs. missing for 10: explicit side-by-side comparison UI/feature description, regression-detection mechanics across versions, independent/hands-on confirmation of comparing runs.
